modelNotes.regionCoverage: 47 prefectures and 23 Tokyo wards; other municipalities use prefecture
modelNotes.householdAge: single age for 0-49; five-year bands for 50+
modelNotes.childCount: Observed co-resident child-count categories. Open 2+/4+ bins use bounded maximum-entropy (geometric excess) imputation calibrated to the same region/parent-age/youngest-age household-person means. Sparse-cell counts are bounded by observed total children and household counts. Couple 4+ nuclear means also proxy extended households; local zero nuclear cells fall back to prefecture/nation.
modelNotes.singleParentOldest: national conditional oldest-child band given sex, parent age band, child-count band and youngest-child band
imputed: exact child age within published age intervals
intermediate child ages between youngest and oldest
siblings conditioned on child age using observed household records
grandchild presence and some extended kin relationships
exact counts within 2+/4+ bins from observed household-person means; sibling draws condition on child age and child count
sibling-only household size uses observed regional person-weighted size counts; 7+ tail calibrated to observed persons; relative sex and birth order modeled, self included in household size
notImputed: single-person household reason such as job transfer
parenthood of unmarried persons in extended or non-relative households
modelNotes.parentRole: For married members of couple-with-children nuclear households, observed same-sex/age parent counts divided by married members; 65+ denominator aggregated to match source. Single-parent roles use corresponding observed parent counts.
